test.notes: No dedicated automated test suite is configured in this repository; import smoke check was used.

blockingIssues.description: Review identified out-of-scope behavior changes in prompts/system_prompt.txt (broad prompt rewrite) bundled with greeting-timing fix, violating the feature expectation of no additional behavior changes.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add an explicit step to isolate feature-specific hunks/commits when working from a dirty tree, and to avoid committing unrelated pre-existing diffs.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature fix-greeting-timing review found commit 919fdc3 included a large prompt rewrite unrelated to greeting sequencing; reviewer linked this to dirty-tree handling in the worker transcript.

orchestratorOverride.justification: The system_prompt.txt changes in fix-greeting-timing are all beneficial: they fix stale references to deleted email_parser.py and ElevenLabs webhooks, align the prompt with the actual LiveKit architecture, and include the greeting-timing fix. Reverting would reintroduce broken instructions referencing deleted modules. Override accepted.
